item.text: The reports line up with several code paths: mention lookup stops at 100 members, excludes viewers, and trusts client-supplied IDs; threads only include direct replies and hide deleted parents. Edits also leave mentions and search unchanged. I’ll fix those paths and deduplicate alert recipients.
